d:
The Rockets defeated the Celtics, 109-93 tonight in Houston. Alperen Sengun contributed a team-high 26 points to go with 10 assists 7 rebounds and 2 steals, with Jabari Smith Jr. of the Rockets adding an additional 14 points (5-10 FG, 4-5 3P) in the game. Jayson Tatum finished with a team-high 19 points along with 9 assists for the Celtics in the losing effort. The Rockets improve their record to 7-1 with the win, while the Celtics fall to 5-2 for the season.
